Reference / time/clock

time/clock#

Wall-clock and monotonic time are deliberately different nominal values.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let clock = SystemClock();
let before = clock.monotonic_instant();
await clock.wait(Duration(milliseconds: 5));
let elapsed = clock.monotonic_instant().minus(before);

Description#

Wall-clock and monotonic time are deliberately different nominal values.

Instant is a duration from the Unix epoch and may later be interpreted by civil-time modules. MonotonicInstant is only a runtime-local reading suitable for ordering and elapsed-time measurement. It has no Unix/civil projection. Runtime readings carry a domain; comparisons across domains are rejected. The one-argument constructor binds explicitly supplied readings to the "explicit" domain and never claims compatibility with a live clock.
